output.explanation: The warehouse doesn't track inventory or stock levels. marts.dim_products only has the SKU, name, category, list price, unit cost and an is_active flag. None of the tables has stock on hand, inventory movements or warehouse quantities, so I can't work out the current stock level of the ergonomic office chair. I can show its product details, such as whether it's active, its price and cost, or its sales volumes from marts.fct_order_lines.
